description: The erection of a dormer extension at loft level to the rear roofslope over the main house, with 2 rooflights to the front roofslope, the erection of a rear dormer extension over the two-storey rear outrigger and the alteration of the rear pitched roof over the existing rear outrigger, to be raised with a flat roof profile and the removal of the rear chimney stack over the existing outrigger, alongside the addition of a new rear window at first floor level to a terraced house.
decision_conditions:
Your property falls within a Flood Zone and/or in an area where there is evidence of a risk from other sources of flooding, including surface water, ground water and sewer flooding therefore a Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) is required for your application.
